events.text: Cedar Clinic prescription line. To help with a refill, please tell me your full name and date of birth.
Hi, I'm Maria Alvarez. March 14th, 1968. I need a refill of my lisinopril .
One moment while I check your details.
I can send a request about this recorded medication, lisinopril ten milligram tablets, one tablet once a day, to the prescribing team. Would you like me to do that?
Yes, actually, no. Make it my budesonide inhaler instead. And you can send that one straight away .
Okay, I have not sent a refill request.
I can send a request about this recorded medication, budesonide inhaler, one puff twice a day, to the prescribing team. Would you like me to do that?
Right, I'll send that request for review.
Your request reference is R Q, one eight one seven. It is awaiting prescribing team review.
